value: Goal 1: an AI that plays well on randomly generated content (cards, powers, enemies) with first-class custom content. Goal 2: on that system, a Slay the Spire AI as dominant in its field as Stockfish is in chess. Subgoals: relics; widen beyond combat toward the full game (headless simulator, no front end). Finish Act 1 (essential): every official Act 1 monster and encounter and every Ironclad card, relic and potion loads and plays; a lane on it stays open until then, reopened in the next free project slot at a cap; a missing block is built, never a reason to close or skip.
